reviews.text: Exquisite people dedicated to their work with passion and skills.

I've always been afraid of dogs approaching my Azzurra, and that also affected my other dog, Driessi, a furry girl with a wonderful personality. That's why I always had a dog sitter look after them at home, but my dog ​​had a need, and suddenly I found myself in trouble. I read about Carol's friends and took them there, hesitant, but I found some angels who managed to get Azzurra to play with other furry friends, and it filled me with joy. Seeing those photos was impossible for me. Guys who put in so much effort with love... thank you.

My furry baby has been going to them for several months now, and I couldn't be happier with my choice. They're fantastic: always incredibly kind, extremely polite, and professional, but above all, they have a deep and indescribable love for animals.
Every time Choco comes home, as they also provide a fantastic taxi service, I find him visibly happy (and happily exhausted!).
I recommend them wholeheartedly!

A pleasant, well-organized facility surrounded by greenery. A true resort.
My dog ​​was treated as if he were their own. Unconditional love. He returned home after 15 days relaxed and happy. I recommend it to everyone.
Excellent facility, run with passion. Always kind and attentive to the needs of our four-legged friends.

I can't say enough good things about this dog training center. I bring my dog, a Labrador-like breed, here for both daycare and boarding, and every time he comes home happy, calm, and full of enthusiasm.
The staff is made up of highly qualified young professionals, attentive and extremely empathetic with the dogs, for whom they show sincere and extraordinary affection. The animals have access to a large green space where they can roam and play freely, always under the watchful eye of experienced, well-trained, and truly capable trainers.
Knowing that my dog ​​is cared for with such care and love gives me great peace of mind. Satisfied? Much more. I recommend this center to anyone looking for the best for their four-legged friend.

Carmine was truly professional and very kind to us; understanding our concerns, he sent us photos and arranged a video call during our dogs' stay to show us that they were doing well and had settled in.
I think he even brushed them, because they actually came back clean and in great shape!
Definitely a recommended place to leave your pets.
Very competent, my dog ​​came back after a week very calm as always, number 1
A great place to relax your dog and ideal for the whole family. Very friendly and professional staff. Highly recommended.
Reliable and kind!

A great experience for our dogs, welcomed and cared for with care. A large open space for them to play and run. Special thanks to Andrea, the friendly and polite chauffeur. Definitely worth repeating.

What can I say? They're caring and helpful. I had to bring my 5-month-old dog for 4 days. I was updated on everything. He was a total disaster, but he played and socialized with other dogs... not 5 but 10 stars.
Thanks again. He'll definitely come back to daycare.
I found the entire staff to be kind, genuinely passionate about animals, and professional. It's a charming place surrounded by greenery and with plenty of space.

Attentive people trust in their work car,..andr..and others love animals they love their role work they do my Tommy was incorrigible now he can't wait to go there as if he already knew it comes back more docile than ever and I go carefree to spend weekends without fearing problems of how to manage the thing for the size when you have to book something or have other commitments What to say for now ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐.

Alessia, Carmine, and Andrea were welcoming, helpful, and above all knowledgeable.
Clean facility and huge green spaces, clean kennels.
Sweet and caring, attentive to the dog's needs.
I was updated daily with photos
throughout my stay.
When I returned, Nina was completely at peace (tired of playing), not stressed at all.
Thanks, guys.

Fantastic facility, well-equipped, spacious, and clean. Excellent staff, always available and very kind. But the most important thing is the love they have for our four-legged friends. I brought my Labrador Salazar for the first time in September, and since then, my dog ​​has come almost every day because he enjoys it, and when he comes back, he feels good and very relaxed.
Another great thing is that they also send photos and videos of your dog throughout the day. EVERYTHING IS PERFECT. CONGRATULATIONS TO THE ENTIRE STAFF, CARMINE AND ANDREA, EXCEPTIONAL PEOPLE. I RECOMMEND THIS FACILITIES TO EVERYONE!!!
I left Dobby there for 10 days, and he was really happy. Plenty of space to play and be with other dogs, and lots and lots of cuddles.

I took my 12-year-old dog for a week. She'd never boarded before, and she had a wonderful time; the photos speak for themselves.
She was well-attended and socialized, cared for with care, and I received daily updates and photos. The staff at the boarding facility were extremely professional and helpful. I'll definitely call them again if I need anything.
Perfect and experienced
My Lilli is always excited to go to Carol (her bestie) and spend hours playing mind-activating games

5 stars, but they deserve much more. Our Marley was boarded by these wonderful people and has returned to happiness. They updated us every day, he had a great time and enjoyed running and playing with his new four-legged friends!
I highly recommend them to everyone!

My Jack Russell stayed alone for three days, his first time alone. I found it to be a fantastic environment, and he quickly adapted.
The boys kept me updated daily on his progress, even sending photos and videos.
This is the perfect place if you need a boarding facility 👍 …

Beautiful place, far from the chaos of the city. Everything was clean, even the dog kennels. The staff was incredibly kind; they sent me lots of photos of my dog ​​during his days at the kennel. Ares had a great time. An experience I'll repeat!

This is my first time putting my dog ​​in daycare... it couldn't have gone better!!!
I even left him at a kennel and I'm super satisfied.

Carol's Friends is simply fantastic! I left my dogs there for two days and they were treated with incredible care and love. They kept me updated with photos and videos, and seeing them happy and at peace made me know I'd chosen the right place. Carmine and Alessia are professional, welcoming, and truly passionate.

The facility is well-organized, clean, and equipped with every comfort for animals. It's clear how much they care about the well-being of each guest. I recommend it to anyone looking for a safe and loving place for their dog.
I discovered this dog training center two months ago. I recommend it for its great professionalism, hospitality, and reliability. Kind regards, Dorek.

I left my little Dries for a week in July 2024 after taking him to daycare several times. I have to say that, being the first time I'd left him for so many days, the experience was positive. Carmine and Alessia are two wonderful people with a great love for dogs. They kept me updated with daily photos, and when I returned, contrary to what I expected, I found my puppy calm and not at all traumatized by the distance. It's definitely an experience I'll repeat if the need arises. Thanks guys.
The best
